summary: Recent updates span security patches, AI‑driven media tools, and process automation insights. Python’s latest releases address critical CA key compromises, while Google’s Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash offers cost‑effective video generation. UiPath introduces Delegate to streamline busywork testing and shares AI adoption insights from retail and oil & gas sectors. Automation Anywhere delivers HR automation guidance, AI‑powered ticket resolution, and a five‑phase agentic AI roadmap, complemented by Microsoft’s Power Platform community highlights.
